payload.name: Motivation and trigger retrieval for why-start questions
payload.description: When a question asks why someone decided to start, launch, or begin an activity or business, use this Skill to retrieve both personal passion and precipitating trigger events before answering.
content: When the question asks why someone decided to start/launch/begin an activity or business, run at least one extra search combining the person's name with motivation terms ('passion', 'love', 'always wanted', 'dream', 'inspired') and at least one search with trigger terms ('lost job', 'left job', 'opportunity', 'decided', 'finally', 'after') if the initial results lack either.

When reviewing retrieved memories, treat both the person's expressed interest/passion and any triggering life event as evidence for the decision; do not answer from a single memory if it covers only one side.
Stop as soon as you have at least one memory covering the motivation and one covering the trigger, or after 2-3 targeted searches; do not exhaustively retrieve all business-related events.

solves: Answers for 'why did X start/launch Y' often require both a personal motivation (interest/passion) and a triggering event (e.g., job loss, opportunity). The default single-search flow may retrieve only one side, leading to incomplete answers. This Skill adds targeted searches for both dimensions before answering.
